paragraphs.text: Sync AiSpot (sapi) group pricing in DeepSeek Harness and show per-turn and per-session cost, includi
ng the whole subagent subtree.
# sapi-budget

A DeepSeek Harness plugin that syncs the per-group model prices from an
AiSpot (`sapi`) deployment a

nd shows what each
conversation costs — a session total in the conversation header and a per-turn
co
st at the end of every assistant turn.

The group list is crawled from the provider, never hardcoded, so it follows the
provider as groups a

ppear and disappear. You pick the active group from a
dropdown in the conversation header, and every

historical number is re-priced
immediately — no reload, no replay.
## What it shows

- **Session total** in the conversation header, including every descendant
subagent (`subtree(s) = o

wn(s) + Σ subtree(children)`).
- **Per-turn cost** at the end of each assistant turn.
- A hover brea
kdown listing the model, the tokens per bucket, and the total.

Money is never published by the host. The projection carries token buckets only,
and the browser pri

ces them against the live catalog — that is what makes a
group switch re-price history instantly.
## Install
[代码示例省略，未执行]
Or from a local checkout:
[代码示例省略，未执行]
Then restart the app: the bundle is loaded at startup.

Runs on macOS, Windows and Linux. There is no platform branch anywhere in the
plugin: the host half

is plain JavaScript that registers routes and a session
projection and writes nothing to disk, prici

ng comes from public HTTP endpoints,
and the stored group choice lives in the browser's `localStorag

e`. The UI uses
only theme tokens, so it follows the host's light and dark palettes.
## Configuration
All optional. Set them in your profile patch (`cordis.patch.yml`):
[代码示例省略，未执行]

The group is normally chosen in the UI and persisted in the browser's
`localStorage` (`sapi-budget.g
roup`); the config value is only a fallback.
## Pricing data
Three public, unauthenticated endpoints on the provider:
| Endpoint | Used for |

| `/api/pricing` | model list, ratios and `tiered_expr` expressions |
| `/api/status` | quota unit a

nd exchange rate |
| `/api/user/groups` | group names and per-group ratio multipliers |

Tiered expressions are evaluated by a hand-written tokenizer and recursive-descent
parser in `pricin
g.js`. There is no `eval` and no `new Function`.
## Accuracy notes

- Tiered models are marked as estimates (`估算` / `estimate`) in the UI.
- A subagent's spend is price

d at the root session's model rate, because
cross-session model attribution is not available on the

host side. Those rows
are labelled as estimates too.
- Subagents that finished before the plugin was

installed have no readable
projection. They are reported as **unknown**, never as `$0.00`.
## Layout
| File | Role |
| `index.js` | Host half: pricing service, three HTTP routes, the `sapiCost` session projection, and

the `sapi_price` agent tool |
| `client.js` | Browser half: the two slot entries, the group picker,

and the tooltip bubble |
| `pricing.js` | Catalog fetching and the `tiered_expr` evaluator |
| `tes

t/` | 45 host tests + 59 client tests |
| `probe-tooltip.mjs` | Structural check that the breakdown
does not ride on a native `title` |
## Development

`HANDOFF.md` records the architecture decisions and the traps that cost real time
(including why the

cost breakdown must never be a multi-line native `title` on
macOS).
